title: WooCommerce Launch
description: Pre-launch checklist for WooCommerce stores — payments, tax, shipping, and legal pages

steps.title: Run WooCommerce Setup Wizard
steps.instructions: Complete the WooCommerce setup wizard if not already done. Set store address, currency, and selling location.

steps.title: Configure payment gateways
steps.instructions: Enable and configure Stripe or PayPal. Add API keys from client's payment processor account. Test with a $1 order.

steps.title: Configure tax settings
steps.instructions: Enable tax calculation. Set up tax rates for the client's jurisdiction. Verify prices display correctly with tax.

steps.title: Set up shipping zones and methods
steps.instructions: Create shipping zones for all regions the client ships to. Add flat rate or real-time rates. Add free shipping threshold if applicable.

steps.title: Configure email notifications
steps.instructions: Set From name and From address to client's business. Customise email templates with logo and brand colours.

steps.title: Create required legal pages
steps.instructions: Create Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Refund Policy, and Shipping Policy pages. Assign them in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced.

steps.title: Set up transactional email (SMTP)
steps.instructions: Install and configure an SMTP plugin (WP Mail SMTP, FluentSMTP). Connect to SendGrid, Mailgun, or Postmark. Send a test email.

steps.title: Place a test order end-to-end
steps.instructions: Place a complete test order. Verify payment processes, order confirmation email is received, stock decrements, and admin order notification fires.

steps.title: Enable and verify SSL checkout
steps.instructions: Confirm checkout page forces HTTPS. Check for mixed content warnings. Verify payment gateway is in live (not test) mode.
